recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, close-up male portrait set against a soft blue gradient background, framed by a thick white border. The composition features a secondary geometric badge element on the right and wide-spaced sans-serif text at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a vertical rectangular inset
Geometric badge overlapping the right edge of the inner frame
Wide-tracked title text floating in the top white margin
Color harmony between the blue shirt, background, and badge accents
coreInvariants: Soft, diffused studio lighting on the face
Geometric graphic element with high-contrast borders

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Head and shoulders portrait, centered horizontally, filling approximately 70% of the inner frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the high-contrast black/red badge on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top title, moves down to the face, then shifts right to the graphic badge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial white margin surrounding the central image creates a clean, framed look.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red and purple (badge borders and title text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key overall with localized pops of high saturation in the graphic elements.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain soft pastel midtones for the background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying tracking and color to distinguish roles.
graphicDevices: Rectangular badge with thick red border
Diamond/lozenge shape behind the badge with purple/blue gradients

candidateDirections.reason: Classic 80s geometric choice with clean lines.
Matches the era's preference for geometric circular forms.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man with 80s quiff hair, wearing a dark blazer over a light blue shirt, centered against a soft blue gradient background. Frame this image with a thick white border. Place a geometric badge (black rectangle with red border over a purple diamond) on the middle-right edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the top white margin with extreme letter spacing. Add two lines of centered white text inside the black rectangle of the badge.

verificationChecks: Is the tracking on the top text wide enough?
Does the badge overlap the inner frame edge?
Is the background a soft, non-distracting gradient?
Is the white border thick and consistent?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
postGenerationChecks: Check for centered horizontal alignment of the subject
Ensure text is perfectly horizontal and not warped
Verify the badge colors do not clash with the portrait
Confirm the white border is clean and free of artifacts
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Wide-Tracked Header + Geometric Side-Badge + Thick Frame
